All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
Action
Action represents the possible directions the snake can move.
Block
Block represents a cube on the board.
GameController
GameController manages the game logic and user interactions during the game.
GameSettings
GameSettings is responsible for loading and providing access to game configuration from a JSON file.
IntroController
IntroController manages the initial screen and handles user interactions to start the game or exit the application.
Main
Main class to launch the JavaFX application.
Snake
Snake that can move, change direction, eat, bump into blocks, and grow.
SnakeGame
SnakeGame is the main controller of the game, managing the game state and logic.
SnakePart
SnakePart represents a part of the snake's body.
Treat
Treat represents a block on the board that the snake can eat.
Wall
Wall represents an obstacle block on the board.
